record.paper_title: Progress and open questions in the physics of neutrino cross sections at intermediate energies
record.original_question: How strongly does the near-threshold Λ(1405) resonance affect weak antikaon production cross sections in neutrino interactions, and what changes to current theoretical descriptions are required if that resonance contributes non-negligibly?

evidence.quote: The presence of a baryon resonance, Λ(1405), just below the KN¯ threshold might have a non negligible influence on the weak K¯ production cross sections that needs to be investigated.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the weak production of antikaons ($\bar{K}$) off nucleons induced by (anti)neutrinos at intermediate energies (incoming neutrino energies of order $1$–$2$ GeV), i.e., charged-current processes of the form $\bar{\nu}_\ell + N \to \ell^+ + \bar{K} + N'$ (with $N,N'$ nucleons and $\ell$ a charged lepton). Standard theoretical descriptions of these reactions are built from a chiral effective Lagrangian with the lowest-lying baryon octet and decuplet, including $s$-, $u$-, and contact (Kroll–Ruderman–type) diagrams together with kaon-pole and meson-exchange contributions, and yield differential and total cross sections $d\sigma/dE_{\bar{K}}$, $d\sigma/d\Omega$, and $\sigma(E_\nu)$.

Just below the $\bar{K}N$ threshold lies the isoscalar $J^P = 1/2^-$ baryon resonance $\Lambda(1405)$, which couples strongly to the coupled $\bar{K}N$–$\pi\Sigma$ system and is widely interpreted as a dynamically generated state in unitarized chiral perturbation theory (often as a two-pole structure).

Quantify the influence of the $\Lambda(1405)$ resonance on the weak antikaon production cross sections off nucleons in the intermediate-energy regime. Specifically:

(a) Construct a theoretical framework for $\bar{\nu}_\ell N \to \ell^+ \bar{K} N'$ that incorporates the $\Lambda(1405)$ contribution consistently with chiral symmetry and unitarity in the coupled $\bar{K}N$–$\pi\Sigma$ channels (for example, via a coupled-channel Bethe–Salpeter resummation that dynamically generates the $\Lambda(1405)$ poles), together with the appropriate weak transition currents linking the nucleon to the resonance.

(b) Compute the resulting total and differential cross sections and compare them with the predictions of the existing tree-level chiral description that omits the $\Lambda(1405)$, identifying the kinematic regions (in $E_\nu$, in the $\bar{K}N$ invariant mass, and in the outgoing $\bar{K}$ momentum) where the resonance contribution is non-negligible.

(c) Determine which modifications of the current theoretical descriptions (e.g., inclusion of additional diagrams with the $\Lambda(1405)$ in the $s$- or $u$-channel, refitting of low-energy constants, treatment of the two-pole structure, or unitarization of the final-state interactions) are required so that the description remains consistent once the $\Lambda(1405)$ contribution is taken into account.
artifact.category_tag: neutrino-induced antikaon production and baryon resonances
artifact.status_search_result: Searches for theoretical work on weak antikaon production by neutrinos that incorporates the near-threshold Λ(1405) resonance return existing tree-level chiral calculations of single-kaon and antikaon production off nucleons (e.g., charged kaon coherent scattering and chiral-Lagrangian-based amplitudes for $\bar{\nu}N \to \ell^+\bar{K}N$), and a substantial body of work on the dynamical generation and two-pole structure of the Λ(1405) in coupled $\bar{K}N$–$\pi\Sigma$ chiral unitary approaches, but no published quantitative evaluation of the Λ(1405)'s impact on the weak $\bar{K}$ production cross section off nucleons that fully addresses the question. The problem therefore appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Charged kaon production by coherent scattering of neutrinos and antineutrinos on nuclei
status_evidence.snippet: Tree-level chiral Lagrangian-based calculation of (anti)neutrino-induced (anti)kaon production; no explicit Λ(1405) contribution discussed.
status_evidence.claim: Existing weak (anti)kaon production calculations are based on chiral Lagrangians without explicit Λ(1405) inclusion.

status_evidence.title: Antikaon-nucleon interaction and Λ(1405) in chiral SU(3) dynamics
status_evidence.snippet: Reviews the dynamical generation of the Λ(1405) as a coupled-channel state in chiral SU(3) unitary approaches, with a two-pole structure near the $\bar K N$ threshold.
status_evidence.claim: The Λ(1405) is well established as a near-threshold dynamically generated resonance in $\bar K N$–$\pi\Sigma$ scattering, but its quantitative role in weak antikaon production off nucleons is not addressed.

status_evidence.title: Lattice QCD evidence that the Λ(1405) resonance is an antikaon-nucleon molecule
status_evidence.snippet: Lattice QCD results support a $\bar K N$-molecule interpretation of the Λ(1405).
status_evidence.claim: Supports the strong $\bar K N$ coupling expected to influence weak $\bar K$ production amplitudes near threshold.
